user.title: Sign in to ConnectMQ
user.description: Sign in with your ConnectMQ account. No account yet? Create a free one at {portal_url} (no credit card needed). If you signed up with Google or LinkedIn, set a password first with "Forgot password" in the portal.

mqtt.title: Connect Home Assistant's MQTT
mqtt.description: Home Assistant can connect its MQTT integration to **{broker}** ({host}, port {port}, TLS) with the broker's credentials and the client ID ConnectMQ expects.

data.configure_mqtt: Set up the MQTT integration with this broker

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to ConnectMQ again
reauth_confirm.description: Your ConnectMQ session has expired. Enter your password to continue.
